result.title: Fast and Memory-Light Evaluation of Density-Based Clusterings with the DISCO Index in R
result.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. R package discoCVI available on CRAN
result.summary: DISCO is a recent internal cluster validity index for density-based clustering that, unlike earlier indices, also evaluates the quality of noise labels. The discoCVI package makes DISCO available in R. This article describes the design of the package and a typical workflow, in which DISCO is used to compare clusterings and to choose the parameters of HDBSCAN without ground truth, followed by the implementation introduced in version 0.2.0. DISCO is defined through density-connectivity distances between all pairs of points, so direct implementations store several n-by-n matrices. We show that every quantity DISCO needs can be read off the single-linkage merge tree of the mutual-reachability minimum spanning tree, so that the index can be computed exactly with memory that grows linearly with the number of points, while the running time remains quadratic as in the original definition. The implementation is tested against the previous version, agrees with the original Python implementation to within $3 \times 10^{-13}$, and corrects the score of singleton clusters to match the published definition. In benchmarks, discoCVI is 23 to 138 times faster than its previous version for 500 to 4,000 points and 3 to 9 times faster than the Python reference for 500 to 8,000 points, using a fraction of the memory of both, and it scores 100,000 points in about 50 seconds with less than 200 MB of memory.

AI.brief_summary: 介绍 R 包 discoCVI（0.2.0）：将密度聚类内部效度指标 DISCO 改为在互可达最小生成树的单链接合并树上精确计算所需全部量，使内存随点数线性增长、时间复杂度仍为平方级，并修正单点簇评分；基准显示显著提速降内存。
AI.relevance_reason: 不涉及视觉或多模态推理；但其用合并树替代 n×n 全对相似度矩阵做精确计算的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 相似度/缓存的存储与计算成本，其对噪声标签的评分也可能类比「是否给出有效证据或弃权」的评价方式。
